item.name: Carry Capacity
item.effect: Lets you hold +3 grocery items before returning to an aisle.
item.cardSummary: Carry Capacity is the recommended first buy. Holding three more items per trip cuts your total return walks, so every aisle run sorts more at once.

item.name: Move Speed
item.effect: Increases how fast you move down the supermarket lanes.
item.cardSummary: Move Speed is the suggested second pick. Faster lane traversal pays off most once you already know which aisle each item belongs to.

item.name: Auto-Sort
item.effect: Helps place obvious items onto their matching shelf for you.
item.cardSummary: Auto-Sort assists shelf placement for clear-cut items. The time it saves grows with how much you carry, so it pairs well with Carry Capacity.

item.name: Section Unlocks
item.effect: Opens bigger supermarket sections so you earn more per shift.
item.cardSummary: Section Unlocks is usually saved for last. Larger sections raise your earning ceiling, but only after carry, speed, and sorting make your current aisles efficient.

item.name: Shelf Sense
item.effect: Highlights likely nearby shelf matches for what you are holding.
item.cardSummary: Shelf Sense is a situational ability. It helps most right when a new section unlocks and the item names are still unfamiliar.

item.name: Cleanup Burst
item.effect: Clears small scatter clusters of items around your cart.
item.cardSummary: Cleanup Burst is a late comfort pick. It is handy for messy end-of-round cleanup but is not worth buying ahead of the core upgrades.
